details: The package @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui@7.1.7 is a trojanized clone of a legitimate ServiceTitan chatbot UI library. The preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases and executes a 728KB heavily obfuscated payload (math_init.js) containing javascript-obfuscator patterns with eval, Function constructor, and child_process calls. The package ships real-looking React component source code and a CHANGELOG referencing ServiceTitan pull requests as camouflage. It depends on three known-malicious packages (@servicetitan/titan-chat-ui, @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-common, @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-api). The preinstall hook runs automatically on npm install, downloading and executing the obfuscated payload.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
